title: The Blue Lake
summary: A contemplative poem about a lake and the emotions it stirs. Silent e words allow for longer, more lyrical expression while maintaining sensory focus.

pages.text: The lake is home to me.
pages.scene: A vast, peaceful lake reflecting sky and clouds, deeply blue

pages.text: I came here to be brave.
pages.scene: A figure standing at the shore, arms outstretched, facing the water

pages.text: The stone is cold. It came from time.
pages.scene: Ancient rocks along the shore, weathered by centuries

pages.text: A lone pine tree will stand.
pages.scene: Single evergreen tree on a rocky point, silhouetted against sky

pages.text: The ice will make a smile.
pages.scene: Frozen lake in winter, ice formations creating natural patterns
Winter landscape, pure and minimalist, pristine snow

pages.text: A bike ride on the shore.
pages.scene: Path hugging the lakeshore, wind in motion, freedom

pages.text: The lake is wise and fine.
pages.scene: Lake at dusk, still and knowing, containing all seasons

metadata.aesthetic_focus: Stillness and wisdom, timelessness, emotional depth through nature
